_why: chain_match_eval pairs a card with its handout by normalising the challenge NAME to a directory name. A card whose name is not the directory name is unmeasurable, which understates retrieval quality. Fuzzy matching would fix that by guessing, and a wrong pairing silently inflates or deflates top1 -- so every alias here is stated explicitly and carries the measurement that proved it.
_rules: An alias is added only after the card's own signals are checked against that directory's source, and the card is verified to rank first there.
Record how many of the card's signals were found, and name the specific ones that are too distinctive to be a coincidence.
One directory may be claimed by at most one card; a second claimant is an ambiguous source and the eval must skip it, not pick a winner.

Proxy.note: the directory carries the event prefix that the card's name omits

handouts_with_no_chain_card._why: measured 2026-09-25: these directories hold real handout source but no card claims them, so they are a SOLVING backlog, not a retrieval gap. Listing them keeps the two from being confused when top1_rate is read.
